title: AI cooling will progress toward removal of thermal interface materials, says Jentech president
content: Thermal solutions provider Jentech Precision holds an optimistic outlook for 2027 and will proceed with capacity expansion as planned, with its new plant expected to reach full utilization two to three years after beginning production next year. In addition, the company will begin mass production of three-piece vapor chambers in the first quarter of 2027, while its customers continue to test microchannel lids (MCL), according to company president Chin-lung Lin.

title: Phone chip demand may stay weak in 2027, recovery seen in 2028
content: Research firms and industry sources expect the smartphone market to remain sluggish in 2027, with a more noticeable recovery potentially not arriving until 2028. Overall market conditions are expected to remain similar to those in 2026, with Apple and Samsung Electronics maintaining their relative lead while Chinese smartphone brands face weaker shipment momentum across mid- and low-end models and growing challenges in the flagship segment.
